name: more-vertical
description: Three evenly spaced vertical dots for more actions.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Three identical centered dots. Horizontal Outline circle centers are (7.5,12), (12,12) and (16.5,12), each radius 1 at Regular 1.75. Vertical is the rigid 90-degree rotation, with centers (12,7.5), (12,12) and (12,16.5), retaining the same size. Natural Filled dots use radius 1.875, exactly matching the visible Regular Outline exterior. The tiny radius-0.125 Outline interior counter is intentional; Filled removes it. No added unframed box. Regular visible bounds are 12.75 by 3.75 for Horizontal, swapped for Vertical, centered at 12,12. Thin 1.25 and Bold 2.50 retain the radius-1 centerlines. At Bold, the Circle frame still has 1.125px radial clearance. None/Square/Circle reuse the same glyph position and size. Standard frame exteriors span 2..22, with Square radius 4 and Circle radius 10. Outline frame centerlines span 2.875..21.125 with Square corner radius 3.125 and Circle radius 9.125. Framed Filled subtracts the exact three solid Filled circles as transparent negative space. All new forms are drafts pending owner review; existing artwork is unchanged. CURRENT FRAME NONE ENLARGEMENT: the owner requested larger standalone icons while preserving the existing framed glyphs. The preceding shared None/frame size rule is superseded for this identity. Scale native Outline geometry uniformly about12,12 by 1.6590909091 but keep Regular1.75 and round-cap radius.875 fixed. Rebuild Filled from the enlarged centerlines with fixed.875 expansion; do not scale Filled thickness or apply an SVG transform. The dot-axis opposing pair has visible bounds2..22. Circle centerline radius is1.6590909091 and solid Filled radius is2.5340909091, with unchanged stroke1.75. Perpendicular visible size is5.0681818182. Square/Circle source SVGs and metadata are intentionally unchanged and retain the earlier smaller native framed glyph. All revised standalone drawings remain drafts pending owner review.

review.note: New ellipsis icon and frame variants; awaits owner review. Standalone None geometry enlarged at fixed Regular1.75; framed variants unchanged.
